Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in the final analysis step by swapping the death years of the two directors. The WebSurfer correctly identified that Frank R. Strayer died in 1964 and Thomas Carr died in 1997. However, in the final summary, the Planner incorrectly stated that "Tangled Destinies -- Director: Frank R. Strayer; Died: 1997" and "The Daltons' Women -- Director: Thomas Carr; Died: 1964". This misattribution of dates led to the incorrect conclusion that Thomas Carr died earlier, when in reality, Frank R. Strayer (1964) died earlier than Thomas Carr (1997).
